records.title: Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion! (どうも、好きな人に惚れ薬を依頼された魔女です。) — Episode 6 "The Witch and the Promised Love Potion" (Rose)
records.meta: TV anime · Japan · Japanese · Diomedéa / Horemajo Production Committee · ep 6 aired 9 Nov 2026 JST (AT-X; MBS 10 Nov) · streaming on Crunchyroll, TVer, d Anime Store, U-NEXT
records.character: Rose, the 'Witch of the Lake' (a young witch who lives alone and earns her living making potions)
records.summary: Rose, a witch, has been secretly in love with the knight Harij for four years. He asks her to brew a love potion, which she assumes is for another woman. In episode 6 the potion is finished, and Harij asks her to prove it works with a sample. She reluctantly drinks it, and the potion's strong effect leaves her struggling with the love welling up inside her. Per the review, it amplifies her existing feelings and leads to a near-kiss before it wears off. Harij then learns the potion was never meant for him.
records.hypnotist: Self-administered (Rose drinks her own love potion at Harij's request)

episodes.gist: Rose drinks a sample of the finished love potion and struggles with the overwhelming love it stirs; the effect wears off

records.pregnancy_note: Not stated in sources (series still airing).
records.kids_note: Sources mention no children for Rose. The series is still airing, and sources do not say whether she and Harij end up together or have children.
